**Generated by:** openai/gpt-4o-mini | **Approach:** Agent | **Report Date:** 2026-06-06

---

## Coverage Definition

> **Missing coverage** = An entire scenario or behaviour that is completely absent from the generated tests but is present in the ground truth.
>
> **Partial negative coverage is acceptable** — if the ground truth tests multiple individual-field empty/invalid cases and the generated tests cover at least one representative field of the same type, that counts as covered.
>
> **Extra** = scenarios present in the generated tests but not in the ground truth.

### Generated Tests Strengths
- The `gpt-4o-mini` Agent approach maps standard UI flows accurately when the features are purely textual (e.g., Login forms, Course searches, Timeline filters). 
- It excels at generating Edge and Boundary testing variants (such as attempting rapid double-clicks on buttons or entering whitespace into text arrays) without needing explicit instruction.

### Weaknesses (Hallucination & Element Blindness)
- **Role Hallucination:** On complex pages like the Course Page, the agent hallucinated that it possessed Teacher privileges, generating 6 test cases for adding new course sections and activities despite its preconditions stating "User logged in as <Student>".
- **File System Blindness:** The model systematically ignored file-handling features across the entire Moodle LMS. It generated 0 test cases regarding Profile Picture uploads/removals and missed testing MIME types for Assignment file uploads.
